name: org.ae.einvoice/directory
title: einvoice.ae.org directory
description: Read-only UAE e-invoicing data: ASP directory with MoF and Peppol status, deadlines, guides.

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Search the directory of UAE e-invoicing accredited service providers (ASPs). Returns MoF accreditation and Peppol access point / SMP status, the profile URL and when it was last checked. Coverage by emirate and pricing are not recorded for most providers.

query.description: Part of a provider name or brand, e.g. 'zoho'. Optional.

accreditation.description: mof = on the Ministry of Finance register (default), not_mof = listed only by Peppol, all = both.

peppol_access_point.description: Only providers certified as a Peppol access point.

peppol_smp.description: Only providers certified as a Peppol service metadata publisher.

locale.description: Language of the text returned. Default en.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Details of one provider by slug (from search_providers): legal name, MoF number, Peppol status, same-brand Peppol entities abroad, website and sources.

locale.description: Language of the text returned. Default en.

tools.name: list_deadlines
tools.description: The e-invoicing rollout timeline: ASP appointment deadlines and go-live dates by business group, with whether each is passed or upcoming today (UAE date) and the official source.

locale.description: Language of the text returned. Default en.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Without a slug, lists the guides. With a slug, returns the guide's short answer and full text in Markdown, with its updated date.

slug.description: Guide slug. Omit to list guides.

locale.description: Language of the text returned. Default en.
